caption_fb:
Three empires, three waves of leaving.

Before World War I:
🔹 about 600,000 people left the Prussian partition for the US
🔹 about as many left Austrian Galicia, with a big wave around 1900
🔹 over 750,000 left the Russian partition for the US and Brazil combined

Knowing which empire your family left can tell you which archives to search and which language the records may be in.

Which wave was your family? Tell us in the comments 👇
